initialExam.title: Tamil Nadu Police Constable 2026
initialExam.conductingBody: Tamil Nadu Uniformed Services Recruitment Board
initialExam.description: TN Police Constable recruitment for Grade II Police Constable, jail warder, and fireman posts in Tamil Nadu.
initialExam.eligibility: 10th or 12th pass from a recognized board
initialExam.syllabus: GK, Tamil, English, Aptitude, TN History, Indian Polity, Science.
initialExam.examPattern: Written Test: 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 minutes. Physical Test.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Physical Measurement → PET → Medical → Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Grade II Police Constable in Tamil Nadu Police
initialExam.careerGrowth: Constable → Head Constable → SI → Inspector → DSP.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit tnusrb.tn.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
